title: A bit stiff, and larger holes then expected, but washed good.
text:
A bit stiff, and larger holes then expected, but washed good.. I received this in white, Not the cute design, but has a pink zipper.
The mesh is a bit stiff, even after washing, and is not a fine soft mesh as my other ones are. These have
Larger holes.
I used this to wash one bra , although I’m sure I could have put two inside this.
Washed this in my front load washer.

It wash fine, I also had our regular clothes with this wash also as I usually do when
I use these bags for delicate items.
I do not put these bags in the dryer, or what is inside them, just lay them on top of the warm dryer to dry.

I think $ 7.00 is pricey for just one bag.
